name: Blenheim Palace
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Blenheim Palace, in Woodstock near Oxford, is a vast Baroque mansion built between 1705 and 1722 as a national reward for the Duke of Marlborough's victory at the Battle of Blenheim. Set in parkland shaped by Capability Brown, it is still home to the Churchill family. Winston Churchill was born here, which draws many visitors.
